llm.summary: This is a clearly disclosed cloud image-generation skill that uses a pinned dLazy CLI and uploads prompts or selected media only as part of its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Network calls to api.dlazy.com and uploads to files.dlazy.com are disclosed and proportionate for cloud image generation, including local media paths supplied by the user.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses npm/npx for a pinned @dlazy/cli version and cites source/provenance, but users are still trusting an external package.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Trigger phrases include generic image-generation terms, so agents should confirm intent before invoking paid cloud API calls or uploading local files.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The CLI stores a dLazy API key in the user config directory for reuse; this is disclosed, scoped to the service, and revocable, with no evidence of hidden persistence or privilege escalation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The documented capability, CLI commands, API endpoints, and examples all align with generating or editing images through dLazy/Nano Banana 2.0.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using dLazy as a third-party cloud service. Prompts and any local media paths you provide may be sent to dLazy, generated files are hosted by dLazy, and the CLI may store an API key locally; confirm before uploading sensitive images or making paid API calls.
llm.findings:
[AE1] unexpected: The referenced English and Chinese skill files were both present and inspected, so the partial-inspection concern is not supported by the local artifact review.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger terms are real and could cause unintended invocation, but they are visible trigger metadata for an image-generation skill rather than hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior.
[P9] unexpected: Manual inspection of the flagged long table spacing found formatting alignment only, with no concealed instructions or hidden payload after the whitespace.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese file naturally gives Chinese user-facing guidance; it does not force a language switch outside that localized document.
[SQP-2] expected: Local file upload to dLazy media storage is explicitly documented in the How It Works section and is expected for cloud image-to-image processing, though point-of-use confirmation is advisable.
